tools.name: metersphere.bug.import.preview
tools.description: Validate rows or a base64 XLSX (exclusive). Headers: title, description, handleUser, custom:<fieldId>. No formulas; max 100 rows/5 MiB. Returns previewHash and per-row errors. Requires BUG_WRITE.

tools.name: metersphere.bug.import.commit
tools.description: Commit a previewed import using unchanged content and previewHash. Each row has its own transaction and persistent idempotency. Returns SUCCEEDED/PARTIAL/FAILED with row results; retries never duplicate successful rows. Requires BUG_WRITE.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.attachment.upload.prepare
tools.description: Prepare an ordinary case attachment upload, bound to token/project/purpose/file hash. 5 MiB per file, 15 minute expiry. Does not attach it to a case.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.attachment.upload.complete
tools.description: Complete a prepared upload with matching base64 bytes. Returns temporary attachmentId; use attachment.attach or comment.create to associate it. Same uploadId and file replay safely.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.case.delete_preview
tools.description: Versioned case lifecycle: case.delete_preview. Deletion requires a short-lived preview and the owner's explicit decision in confirmationPath; never substitute confirm=true. CURRENT is default; ALL is explicit. Restore never restarts tasks. New delete/restore scopes are not implied by AGENT_ALL.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.export.retry
tools.description: Retry your failed, cancelled or expired export using its original filters and fields against CURRENT case content. Creates a new linked task. Reuse requestId after a lost response.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.export.start
tools.description: Create an idempotent Excel/XMind export. request uses web export fields: selectIds/selectAll, moduleIds, systemFields/customFields/otherFields (id/name), isMerge. Poll status, then download chunks.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.export.status
tools.description: Read or stop your own durable export task. Stopping a completed task preserves success.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.export.stop
tools.description: Read or stop your own durable export task. Stopping a completed task preserves success.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.export.download
tools.description: Read up to 65536 bytes as base64 at offset, with fresh authorization. Append chunks until eof. Never returns a public file URL.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.import.precheck
tools.description: Durable Excel/XMind import: precheck. Precheck freezes logical cases, template and overwrite versions (10000 cases/50 MiB, 24h). Commit queues per-case transactions. Get reports every item; retry only pending/failed items, never already committed writes. Explicit CASE_IMPORT_V2 required. Optional commit.followup creates or appends a plan/review pair; PLAN_WRITE and REVIEW_WRITE are additionally required. Missing followup preserves legacy import-only behavior; get reports LEGACY.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.snapshot.create
tools.description: Freeze a case-library query for complete paged extraction (15 minutes, 10000 cases/50 MiB). Ordinary search remains live. query uses the functional search request fields.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.snapshot.page
tools.description: Read frozen case contents. Current authorization and existence are checked; invalid scope requires a new snapshot.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.snapshot.release
tools.description: Release your temporary extraction snapshot; does not delete cases.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.execution.contract
tools.description: Read case steps, contentHash and policyHash for structure-only direct execution. Agent declares SUCCESS/ERROR; actual text is not compared with expected. Cover every original position; extras and repeats are allowed and retained.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.execution.evidence.upload
tools.description: Stage a PNG/JPEG evidence file as base64 (max 5 MiB), at case scope; one image covers all steps; hashes/stepNum/purpose optional. Requires FUNCTIONAL_SUBMIT and CASE_ATTACHMENT. Not visible until gate passes.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.execution.submit
tools.description: Validate original-step coverage and evidence structure, then publish Agent-reported results. Extra and repeated positions are retained; any ERROR makes the case ERROR. No expected-text comparison or content reviewer. ACCEPTED/PUBLISHED means structure accepted, not independently verified execution. Requires FUNCTIONAL_SUBMIT and CASE_ATTACHMENT.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.execution.get
tools.description: Read an authorized direct execution report with step outcomes, evidence mapping and frozen global policy. Sensitive facts are redacted.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.archive.prepare
tools.description: Archive execution facts independently from results: prepare. TASK uses an ended managed run; SUBMISSION uses an accepted personal submission. Data requires sourceObjectId/reuseConditions/cleanupStatus and current project file-add permission. Sensitive fields are redacted; reported data is not independently verified. Repeat the same archive; never create fake data when none exists.

Repeat the same archive; never create fake data when none exists.

tools.name: metersphere.functional.module.move
tools.description: Modify a case module. Explicit CASE_MODULE_WRITE_V2 grant required. parentId=NONE moves to project root; root itself cannot move.
